pages.heading: Meet Brennen.
paragraphs: Shipwrecked on a beach he's never heard of. Cage door finally open. Sand in his fur. Zero plan.
And he's already looking for someone to help.

pages.heading: This is Pygmy.
paragraphs: While Brennen was trapped under that crate hollering for help, Pygmy found his shipping label and started reading it.
Turns out he has the strongest tail in the Posse. He just didn't see the need to rush.

pages.heading: That's Gretel.
paragraphs: Brennen tried to rescue her. She bit her way free, spread her gliding membranes, and left.
She did grab Brennen on the way out — mostly because he was slowing her down.

pages.heading: That's Willow. And yes, that's Brennen again.
paragraphs: She said tree hollow. He said thornbush.
Nobody moved. The nets closed in anyway.
These two are going to be a problem.

pages.heading: The Awesome Aussie Possum Posse.
paragraphs: One shipwreck. Six survivors. Three of them already arguing about who's in charge.
Nobody volunteered for this. Nobody's going home either.

pages.heading: Heading east.
paragraphs: No map. No money. Somewhere ahead: a city called Philadelphia and a zoo with their names on the cages.
Hanna built a stagecoach from a tumbleweed. Pygmy has a rabbit that won't cooperate.
